title: ENERGIRON® for LKAB’s plant in northern Sweden
lineage: Supplier announcement distinguishing equipment already used at Luleå from the basic-engineering agreement for Gällivare.

passages.quote: following its successful use in the full-hydrogen pilot plant in Luleå
passages.note: The named ENERGIRON technology was used at the HYBRIT Luleå pilot. It was then selected for basic engineering for Gällivare.

passages.quote: securing environmental permits and a Final Investment Decision
passages.note: Further equipment supply and construction were conditional in this 2024 announcement.
